definitions.explanation: The very highest or most excellent degree of something. Used to describe something that has reached the pinnacle of quality, status, or importance.

examples.japanese: {至高|しこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{至高|しこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}える→言う：00515_iu⟧だろう。
examples.english: This could be called the ultimate dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{至高|しこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧で⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦そのもの→そのもの：27432_sonomono⟧だった。
examples.english: For him, music was the supreme art form and life itself.

notes:
Composed of {至|し} (to reach the utmost) and ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ (high). The word conveys a sense of the absolute highest level.

Often used in literary, formal, or emphatic contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧ is more common for expressing "the best" or "supreme."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {至高|しこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧ (supreme being)
- {至高|しこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧ (supreme joy)
- {至高|しこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧ (ultimate dish, finest item)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {至高|しこう}: supreme, the very highest (literary, elevated)
- ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧: the best, highest (everyday usage)
- ⟦{究極|きゅうきょく}→究極：13753_kyuukyoku⟧: ultimate, final (emphasis on reaching the end point)
